run_passage_retrieval: run the passage retrieval CLI to retrieve top-k documents for questions using a pretrained retriever model and FAISS index
embed_questions: create embeddings for a list of questions using a pretrained retriever model and BERT tokenizer
index_encoded_data: build a FAISS index from pickled passage embedding files by batching and adding embeddings incrementally
validate_retrieval_results: validate retrieval results by calculating top-k document hits and accuracy across questions
add_passages_to_data: add retrieved passages with id, title, text, and score to the original question data
